ops.section: 2026-10-17 brief: tag dictionaries listed as records that declare no coverage and no tags
ops.body: OM-005 (in common), confirmation review unit 08. `ks brief --at C:/dev/ONI-Mods/common` over the eight nodes warned that the six `tags.md` dictionaries declare no coverage and no tags, and suggested giving them `applies_to` or tags through the write path. A dictionary is read through `ks tags`, and the tag-backfill skill excludes it from its own backfill by destination. Expected: no coverage warning for a `tags.md`. Done instead: left them undeclared, as the OM-002 dictionaries are, and recorded the decision in OM-005's plan.
